metadata.name: Amazeing Ball
metadata.desc: A challenge that will make your head spin!

info.content: Amazeing Ball is a simple strategy game where the player guides a ball through a rotatable maze.
Guide the ball to the finish points in different mazes as fast as possible. Collect as many stars as you can. Complete all the levels to beat the game.

info.title: Instructions
items: The finish points will be initially locked. You need the Yellow Keys to unlock them.
Collect the Yellow Stars scattered around the maze.
Avoid the Red Stars. They will cost you one star. If you collect them with no stars, the level fails.
Portals will teleport the ball. Some of them are locked. Find their keys to unlock them.
